title: Website Documentation CSS layout cuts out information
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

See screenshot. This is observed on https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/query-rules/react/ but the layout bug affects multiple pages.
![Screenshot 2024-09-30 at 6 54 04 AM](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3704728f-c573-439c-82c9-fb313c0f6dc5)

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

Go to https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/query-rules/react/

### Live reproduction

Irrelevant - issue is in supporting documentation, not the product itself

### 💭 Expected behavior

I should be able to read all the text and not have the last two words or so of each sentence lopped off.

### Package version

Irrelevant

### Operating system

OSX Sequoia

### Browser

Edge Latest
